requirement.statement: The type system SHALL expose the schema/ontology kernel through idiomatic Kon declaration syntax.

case.given: A Kon source declares `(scalar #Id :{ repr = String })`
case.when: The type binder processes the source
case.then: The binder SHALL register `Id` as a branded scalar represented by `String`

case.given: A Kon source declares a `mixin` and a `schema` using parent and mixins
case.when: The type binder processes the source
case.then: The binder SHALL register schema symbols whose effective rows include ancestor, mixin, and self members

case.given: A Kon source declares `(relation #works_in :{ from = Server to = Department directed = true })`
case.when: The type binder processes the source
case.then: The binder SHALL register a directed relation with schema-typed endpoints

case.given: A Kon source declares `(schema #Machine :{ alias_of = Server })`, `(relation #member_of :{ alias_of = works_in })`, and `(attr #host :{ alias_of = Server.hostname })`
case.when: The type binder processes the source
case.then: The binder SHALL register schema, relation, and scoped attribute aliases from same-level declarations

case.given: A Kon source declares an alias inside a `schema` body
case.when: The type binder processes the source
case.then: The binder SHALL report that aliases must be same-level declarations

case.given: Schema or relation aliases form a cycle
case.then: The binder SHALL report a diagnostic instead of looping

case.given: A relation or alias `alias_of` target references an unknown schema type
case.then: The binder SHALL report a stable diagnostic code and continue processing remaining declarations

case.given: Schema declarations carry attrs or metadata such as required, description, or storage hints
case.then: The binder SHALL preserve metadata for annotation extraction without changing core row compatibility semantics
